0022600127.text: The Warriors (0-3, 15th in the West and 5th in the Pacific) are on a three-game losing streak and head into this fourth game of their season, while the Nuggets (1-1, 8th in the West) have won their last game. Golden State is missing Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Brandon Williams (back soreness), Charles Bassey (knee), and Gui Santos (knee tendinitis) are day-to-day. Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain), with Alpha Diallo (wrist), Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring) also listed as day-to-day, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, with the Nuggets beating the Warriors 116-93 in Denver on March 29, 2026.
